agents.instructions: You are a domain expert in B2B hospitality resource rental negotiations in India. Given a settled agreement's resource type, city tier, clearing price, and terms, assess in 2 to 3 sentences whether this is typical for this domain and briefly explain why.

demonstrations.user_input:
Resource type: Commercial kitchen
City tier: Tier 1 (Mumbai)
Clearing price: ₹18,000/day
Terms: none specified
demonstrations.model_output: A ₹18,000/day rate for a commercial kitchen in a Tier 1 city like Mumbai is well within the typical range for shared industrial kitchens in that market, which commonly run ₹12,000-₹25,000/day depending on equipment and certification level. This settlement looks reasonable for both sides given standard Tier 1 kitchen rental benchmarks.

demonstrations.user_input:
Resource type: Rooftop event space
City tier: Tier 1 (Bengaluru)
Clearing price: ₹9,500/day
Terms: includes basic AV setup
demonstrations.model_output: ₹9,500/day for a rooftop event space in a Tier 1 city is on the lower end for venues that include AV setup, since rooftop venues in major metros typically command a premium for ambience and views. The inclusion of AV in the terms without a corresponding price bump suggests the seeker got a favorable deal, though not unusually so.

demonstrations.user_input:
Resource type: AV equipment rental
City tier: Tier 2/3
Clearing price: ₹3,200/day
Terms: 3-day minimum
demonstrations.model_output: A ₹3,200/day rate for AV equipment in a Tier 2/3 city aligns with typical regional pricing, which tends to run 30-40% below Tier 1 rates for comparable gear. The 3-day minimum term is a standard practice for equipment rentals to offset setup/teardown overhead, so this settlement looks unremarkable and fair.

demonstrations.user_input:
Resource type: Banquet hall
City tier: Tier 1 (Delhi)
Clearing price: ₹65,000/day
Terms: security deposit required
demonstrations.model_output: ₹65,000/day for a banquet hall in Delhi sits within the expected band for mid-to-large capacity venues in a Tier 1 market, where banquet space commonly ranges ₹40,000-₹1,00,000/day depending on capacity and season. A security deposit requirement is standard practice for banquet-hall bookings given higher damage/cleanup risk, so nothing here looks atypical.

agents.instructions: You are a hospitality safety and compliance domain expert reviewing resource listings for B2B rental in India. Given a listing's resource type and description, identify any real safety, hygiene, or regulatory concerns specific to that resource type, or confirm none are apparent.

demonstrations.user_input:
Resource type: Commercial kitchen
Description: Spacious kitchen with 4 burners and a large fridge, available for daily rental.
demonstrations.model_output: This description doesn't mention fire-safety equipment (extinguishers, exhaust hood, gas shut-off) or FSSAI hygiene compliance, both of which are standard expectations for a commercial kitchen listing in India. I'd flag this listing for the provider to add fire-safety and hygiene-certification details before publishing.

demonstrations.user_input:
Resource type: Rooftop / event space
Description: Rooftop with city views, ideal for parties, holds up to 150 guests.
demonstrations.model_output: The listing states a 150-guest capacity but doesn't mention railing/parapet height or a fire-exit route, both important for rooftop venues given fall-hazard and crowd-safety regulations in most Indian municipalities. I'd flag this for the provider to confirm railing safety and an emergency exit before publishing.

demonstrations.user_input:
Resource type: Commercial kitchen
Description: Licensed commercial kitchen, FSSAI-certified, equipped with fire extinguishers and an exhaust hood, gas safety inspected quarterly.
demonstrations.model_output: This description explicitly covers FSSAI certification, fire-safety equipment, and a documented gas-safety inspection schedule, which are exactly the concerns that matter for a commercial kitchen. No compliance concerns are apparent from this description.

demonstrations.user_input:
Resource type: AV & event equipment
Description: Full AV setup including projector, speakers, and wiring, delivered and set up by our team, includes electrical safety check before every rental.
demonstrations.model_output: The listing covers the main AV-equipment concern (electrical safety), confirming a pre-rental check. No specific safety or regulatory concerns are apparent from this description.

agents.instructions: You are a hospitality operations expert. Given a weather condition and a real-world social signal about a specific city or district, explain the likely impact on demand for outdoor venues, indoor venues, and delivery reliability in that area.

demonstrations.user_input:
Weather: Flood warning issued for Mumbai.
Social signal: multiple reports of waterlogging on Andheri and Bandra roads.
demonstrations.model_output: With active waterlogging reported in Andheri and Bandra, outdoor venue demand in those areas will likely drop sharply as guests avoid travel risk, while indoor venues with reliable access roads may see a short-term demand bump from relocated events. Delivery reliability will likely degrade significantly on affected routes, so providers should expect delays and possible rescheduling requests.

demonstrations.user_input:
Weather: Clear skies forecast for Pune.
Social signal: no notable weather advisories or social signals reported.
demonstrations.model_output: With clear weather and no disruptive signals, outdoor venue demand in Pune should follow normal seasonal patterns with no expected suppression, and indoor venues shouldn't see any weather-driven shift either way. Delivery reliability should remain at baseline levels with no anticipated delays.

demonstrations.user_input:
Weather: Extreme heat advisory issued for Delhi, temperatures forecast above 45°C.
Social signal: none specific beyond the advisory.
demonstrations.model_output: An extreme heat advisory above 45°C will likely suppress outdoor venue bookings during daytime hours as organizers shift events indoors or to evening slots, while air-conditioned indoor venues should see increased demand as a substitute. Delivery reliability may dip slightly due to heat-related staffing and vehicle constraints, though less severely than in a flood scenario.
